findings.title: Restarted OMP is treated as exited until the next state push: its first terminal-query replies and keys are dropped
findings.where: src/workbench/ui/product/model.py:347 (_send drops INPUT/PASTE while pane_exited), :1403 (pane_exited reads only the last snapshot), :535 (an ok RESTART_PANE result does not mark the pane live); src/workbench/backend/ui_server.py:351 (the restart result carries no snapshot); STATE_INTERVAL 0.25 s (service.py:48)
findings.evidence: tests/ui/test_product_restart_independent_p27q.py:178 test_queries_of_the_new_session_are_answered_before_the_next_state_push and :189 test_keys_typed_on_the_new_session_before_the_next_state_push_are_not_lost (red): after ok + a display frame of the new session/generation, a DSR query of the new OMP gets no reply and a typed key is dropped until the next state push
findings.impact: window is <= ~0.25 s after the restart; real OMP 18.4.4 draws later than that, so the live probe did not hit it; a fast-starting pane program would lose its start-up query replies
findings.suggestion: treat a display frame whose (session_id, generation) is newer than the one recorded at the restart request (or the ok result's session_id/generation) as live for that pane

observations: Bridge accepts state/omp_event frames of the OLD OMP session while the old peer is still registered (only possible when a process escaped the OMP session with the bridge socket); they stop once the new OMP registers. Not a defect of this unit (pre-existing bridge design).

Live: with a fresh fake HOME, OMP opens its first-run setup wizard; keys typed before the restarted OMP finished drawing are ignored by OMP itself (scratch check: typing after the draw and after re-attach works; UI attached from start works). The probe therefore disables the wizard in the fake HOME and waits for the redraw; P27Q_WIZARD=1 keeps it.
Restart of the same role is refused with restart_in_progress while its isolation re-check runs (real OMP: several seconds); visible in the footer.
